rows.grounds: numeral component qualifying the following thousands
locative plural indicating the vast number
compound denoting yonic mechanisms or devices
past passive participle describing those subjected to suffering

items.question: What vast multitude of yonic mechanisms inflicts torment on beings?
premises: The number specified is eighty-four thousand.
The locus of suffering is yonic mechanisms or diagrams.
Beings within these mechanisms are tormented.
items.inference: Beings are subjected to torment across an immense array of eighty-four thousand yonic mechanisms.
uncertainties: The grammatical subject of pīḍitāḥ is implied from context rather than stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand yonic mechanisms.
